mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_filter_word (word, level, source, enabled) VALUES (#{word}, #{level}, #{source}, #{enabled})
mapper.select: SELECT id, word, level, source, enabled FROM content_filter_word WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY id
SELECT id, word, level, source, enabled FROM content_filter_word ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, word, level, source, enabled FROM content_filter_word WHERE word = #{word} LIMIT 1
